faq.q: How do I become a VIP?
faq.a: You can become a VIP by visiting the Membership page and selecting the VIP tier. It costs £9.99/month or £299 for Lifetime access.

faq.q: What is included in the VIP membership?
faq.a: VIP members get 20% off merch, FLAC downloads, exclusive pre-releases, and access to the 'Inside the Studio' blog.
If you are a VIP or have purchased the track, go to the Album page. You will see a 'Download' button next to the track.

faq.q: Can I buy a single track?
faq.a: Yes! You can buy individual tracks for £0.99 each directly from the music player.
You should receive an email confirmation from Stripe/Printful. If not, contact support via the Contact page.
We decided not to launch a Discord to focus on making this website the best place for fans!
You can use the Contact page form for specific inquiries.
Badges represent your status and journey. Insiders evolve from Amethyst to Plasma energy. VIPs build from Obsidian to Black Diamond. Lifetime members hold the Legacy metals (Bronze, Silver, Gold).

faq.q: How do I upgrade my badge?
faq.a: First, upgrade your Membership Tier to unlock the path (e.g., become a VIP to unlock Obsidian). Then, active users will automatically evolve their badge by maintaining their streak, creating playlists, or downloading tracks.

steps: Click the Play button on any track or album.
Use the floating player at the bottom to Pause, Skip, or Scrub.
Click the queue icon (three lines) to see what's next.
Go to any Album page.
Insiders: Look for the 'MP3' download icon next to tracks.
VIPs: You will see both 'MP3' and 'WAV' (Lossless) options.
Click to download directly to your device.
Tap the 'FanZone' icon in the bottom menu.
Tap the '+' icon or 'New Playlist'.
Select an album to browse tracks.
Tap tracks to add them (max 20).
Tap 'Publish' at the bottom to save your mix.
Go to the 'FanZone' via the sidebar.
Click 'Create Mix' in the top right.
Select tracks from the album view.
Name your mix and click 'Publish Playlist'.
Visit the 'Shop' page from the menu.
Browse Vinyls, Apparel, and Digital items.
VIPs automatically get 20% off at checkout.
Click 'Buy Now' to purchase securely via Stripe.
Go to the 'Membership' page.
Choose 'Insider' (£3.99) or 'VIP' (£8.99).
Click 'Upgrade' to unlock downloads and playlists immediately.
Go to the 'Radio' tab in the Music section.
Click a station to start listening.
VIPs get access to 'Deep Cuts', 'Demos', and 'Live' stations.
Troubleshooting: If a track fails to play, press the STOP button, wait a second, then press PLAY again to reset the stream.
The FanZone is the community hub for playlists and contests.
Fans: Can start listening to the 'Weekly Challenge' playlist.
Insiders/VIPs: Can CREATE their own playlists and enter contests.
Tap 'New Playlist' or 'Create Mix' to start building your own collection.
Badges are digital collectibles that track your journey.
Insider Path: Amethyst (Raw) -> Crystal (Focused) -> Plasma (Pure).
VIP Path: Obsidian (Stone) -> Carbon (Structure) -> Diamond (Pinnacle).
Lifetime Path: Bronze -> Silver -> Gold Masterpiece.
Unlock them by upgrading your tier and hitting milestones (Time Active, Playlists Created, etc).
